_comment: GENERATED by tools/dump_call_protos.py from /eng/mh.exe (EN-canonical). Every named non-thunk function's committed calling contract. status=='ok' means the storage of every param AND the return is assigned and marshallable; any other status is the machine-readable reason the generator must emit a compile-error stub instead. Consumed by tools/gen_dll_calls.py -> mh_calls.gen.h / mh_calls.gen.cpp. Do not hand-edit.

from_varargs_shape.why:
Two %s. Every literal format reached by this shape is a `%s: %s` variant (0x0050317a u"%s: %s
", 0x00503169 u"%s: %s", 0x00502d0b u"%s: %s
.") -- a caption/detail pair, the detail usually produced by llm_str_ansi_to_wide_scratch (0x004cf3e0) from an ANSI filename or error string.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: Eight sites, all ADD ESP,0xc (3 dwords) immediately after the CALL: 0x004b55a3 (rsr_GetMenuFile), 0x004b657d / 0x004b65e5 / 0x004b671d (llm_ui_main_menu_screen_load), 0x004c2b50 / 0x004c3047 (llm_game_boot_init), 0x004cb18f / 0x004cb267 (llm_ui_entity_info_screen_open). Cross-validated independently of the byte count: each site's format literal contains exactly two %s conversions, so the 3 dwords are format + 2 pointer varargs and not, say, format + one 8-byte double.

from_varargs_shape.why: One INT vararg -- format `init\ai%02d.scr`, the planet index. spawn_invasion_force's sole call.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: SIM1F ninth slice, derived from the raw asm at 0x004dd47b: PUSH order (bottom to top) is G_PLANET_INDEX (int), then the format-string address 0x00506d90, then the dst stack buffer -- ADD ESP,0xc after the CALL (3 dwords = dst + format + int) read-memory-confirmed (83 c4 0c).

from_varargs_shape.why: Two STRING + two INT varargs -- format "%s%s_%02d%02d.DMP", building the base-layout .DMP filename ("init\\" + race letter + "_" + 2-digit planet index + 2-digit landing-spot index). llm_strat_bldg_completion_dispatch's only call, MOTHER-arrival branch (SIM1-G4 fifth slice, 2026-08-22).
from_varargs_shape.evidence: 0x00479963-0x00479969: MOV EAX,0xe58245 (dst); PUSH EAX; CALL 0x004cfb9c. ADD ESP,0x18 after the call (24 bytes = 6 dwords: dst + format + 2 string ptrs + 2 ints) read-memory-confirmed (83 c4 18). PUSH order bottom-to-top (deepest-pushed first): landing_spot_index[planet] (int, 0x00479925), G_PLANET_INDEX (int, 0x0047992b), race_str ("A"/"H", 0x00479954), "init\\" literal (0x0047995c), format string (0x00479962), dst (0x00479968) -- i.e. logical call order dst, format, "init\\", race_str, G_PLANET_INDEX, landing_spot_index[planet].

from_varargs_shape.why: One STRING vararg -- format "panelb\\%s.gfx", building a sprite filename from an icon-name string. TACT1E's llm_tact_ui_sel_panel_init is the sole call site. RESTORED 2026-08-28 by the O4A-C sweep. This shape shipped in the GENERATED tools/data/dll_call_protos.json at commit 62b25e6c (TACT1E) but its declaration here was never committed, so the generated file was ahead of its own input and the next regeneration deleted the shape and broke the build. Reconstructed from that committed row plus a fresh read of the call site; the params are byte-identical to what shipped.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: CALL at 0x00433ede (the pushes run 0x00433ecc-0x00433edd), re-read 2026-08-28: PUSH order (bottom to top) is the icon-name string address (0x00559104 + slot*0xa), then the format-string address 0x005004b4, then dst -- ADD ESP,0xc after the CALL (3 dwords). The format at 0x005004b4 is read-memory-confirmed ANSI "panelb\\%s.gfx" (the decl's `narrow_format` applies), whose single %s pins the trailing slot as a pointer.

from_varargs_shape.why: One %s. Format strings `%s (%s)` / `.%s (%s)` with the leading conversion supplied by the caller.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: llm_strat_invasion_chance_roll and llm_diplomacy_set_relation; ADD ESP,0xc after the CALL (3 dwords).

from_varargs_shape.why: Two %s. The `"%s: %s"` name-plus-reason message shape -- the most common one in the sim set.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: llm_strat_order_queue_dispatch has SIX sites of this shape alone (0x0046814f, 0x00468431, 0x004684b7, 0x00468ad4, 0x00468d5c, 0x00468fb2), every one followed by ADD ESP,0x10 (4 dwords). Also game_AddPlanetToAvailable, game_HandleInvasion, llm_game_notify_system_available, llm_strat_bldg_state_destroyed, llm_strat_player_presence_lost.

from_varargs_shape.why: Three %s. The `"%s: %s (%s)"` name-plus-reason-plus-detail message shape -- SIM1-G4's llm_strat_bldg_state_prod_blocked_notify names the blocked building, the block reason, and (when the reason is a housing shortfall) the specific housing building type, all three as G_TEXT_PTRS lookups.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: llm_strat_bldg_state_prod_blocked_notify @0x00474139, sole site 0x0047421e, format 0x0050133a read-memory-confirmed "%s: %s (%s)" (25 00 73 00 3A 00 20 00 25 00 73 00 20 00 28 00 25 00 73 00 29 00 0000), ADD ESP,0x14 (20 bytes = 5 dwords: dst+format+a0+a1+a2).

from_varargs_shape.why: A double followed by an int -- format `random %.2f  %d`. THE TRAP SHAPE: the decompile renders the double as two dwords (GAME_CLOCK._0_4_, GAME_CLOCK._4_4_) because a double vararg is pushed as 8 bytes, so declaring it as two u32s produces the same byte count and is invisible until a value changes. Declared `double` so gen_dll_calls emits detail::bits() (a bit reinterpret) rather than a numeric conversion.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: llm_debug_roll_random @0x0049fc6f, sole site, ADD ESP,0x14 (20 bytes = 4 + 4 + 8 + 4).

from_varargs_shape.why: Four varargs, int/string alternating -- format `%d (%s)  %d (%s)`. The widest shape the sim set uses, and the one that would catch an off-by-one in the stack layout furthest from the frame base.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: llm_diplomacy_set_relation, ADD ESP,0x18 (24 bytes = six dwords).

from_varargs_shape.why: One INT32 vararg, no %s. llm_strat_invasion_chance_roll's debug print (format string at 0x0050164b, read-memory-confirmed to be an unfilled/all-spaces placeholder -- the call formats into G_TEXT_TMP, which nothing subsequently reads on this path, a dead store). The format string consumes ZERO specifiers (confirmed all-spaces); `a0` is a genuinely unconsumed trailing stack slot the original pushes anyway -- see dump_call_protos.py's allow_unconsumed_tail escape hatch.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: SIM1F third slice (2026-08-16) re-derived from the raw asm at 0x0049960d: PUSH order (bottom to top) is the loop variable `i` (int), then the format-string address 0x0050164b, then G_TEXT_TMP (dst) -- ADD ESP,0xc after the CALL (3 dwords), same frame size as `vs` but the third slot is an int32, not a wchar_t*.

from_varargs_shape.why: Two INT32 varargs -- the order-issue domain's player-control-mode debug line. Both format strings are UTF-16 and read-memory-confirmed to consume exactly two %d and nothing else: 0x005011cc is u"<46 spaces>(%d)<13 spaces>%d" (132 B) and 0x00501250 the same with one space fewer (130 B). The leading run of spaces is a right-alignment pad, NOT a blanked placeholder -- a 40-byte read of either address shows only spaces and reads as the `vi` shape's all-spaces case, which is why the whole string is quoted here. The call formats into G_TEXT_TMP and nothing on either arm reads it back, so the effect is a dead store the translation must still make.
from_varargs_shape.evidence: llm_strat_order_set_player_control_mode (O4C), BOTH sites: 0x0046f9ea (the mask-CLEAR arm) and 0x0046fa19 (the mask-SET arm). PUSH order bottom to top at each is param_2 (int), PlayerSide (MOVZX word from 0x00e58354, int), the format-string address, then G_TEXT_TMP (dst); each CALL is followed by ADD ESP,0x10 -- 16 bytes = 4 dwords. The format strings' two %d conversions independently confirm the two trailing slots are ints and not a pointer pair, which the byte count alone cannot say.

from_varargs_shape.evidence: 0x00433fc3 and 0x00433ffb, both re-read 2026-08-28: PUSH order (bottom to top) is the format pointer, then dst -- ADD ESP,0x8 after each CALL (2 dwords), so there is no vararg tail at all. NOTE THE FORMAT IS RUNTIME-RESOLVED at these sites: the original pushes `dword ptr [0x00584d1c]` / `[0x00584d20]`, i.e. G_TEXT_PTRS[580] / [581], which are 0 in the static image. The specifier cross-check therefore reads an empty string and confirms only that zero varargs are consumed, which is vacuously true; the ADD ESP,0x8 byte count is the whole of this shape's machine evidence, and that is stated here rather than left for a reader to discover from a passing check.

from_varargs_shape.evidence: CALL at 0x0043440f (the pushes run 0x004343fb-0x0043440e), re-read 2026-08-28: PUSH order (bottom to top) is G_TEXT_PTRS[591] (the %s string), then the unit index (the %2d int), then the format-string address 0x005004ca, then dst -- ADD ESP,0x10 after the CALL (4 dwords).
